newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk vessel sinks off Black Sea coast, one dead.
newsitem.headline: Turk vessel sinks off Black Sea coast, one dead.

text.p: One crew member died and two others went missing after a Turkish cargo ship sank in bad weather in the Black Sea off the coast of northern Turkey, a local military official said on Thursday.
"The ship signalled many times that it would sink but because of a storm in the night there was nothing that could be done," the official told Reuters by telephone from the coastal town of Rize.
The 498-tonne vessel Ahmet Akdeniz, carrying 750 tonnes of flour, was en route to the Georgian port of Poti.
Six crew members escaped alive, the military official said.
The body of a crew member was found drowned on Thursday morning and efforts to find the other two were continuing, he said.
